data.name: PMU-UD
data.abstract: The handwritten dataset was collected from 170 participants with a total of 5,180 numeral patterns. The dataset is named Prince Mohammad Bin Fahd University - Urdu/Arabic Database (PMU-UD).

additional_info.summary: The dataset contains handwritten Urdu/Arabic numerals from 0 to 9
additional_info.variable_info: The participants were asked to write the numerals from 0-9 five times each. Participants age ranged from 25-55 years old.
